summary: wait_queue_hosttest.c, which requires a wait that a wake does not end to arm the caller's deadline again before it blocks again, and a wake to be counted for the kinds of change it names and no others, with 6 faults in a private copy of rach2/sys/proc/wait_queue.c; one of three proofs of the host rows on wait deadlines, the timer's tick and the kinds of change a wake counts, split by test; the build copies rach2/sys under the work directory

argv: set -e; rm -rf ${WORK}/b; mkdir -p ${WORK}/b/rach2; cp -R rach2/sys ${WORK}/b/rach2/; cp ${SRC}/rach2/sys/proc/wait_queue.c ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/proc/wait_queue.c; deps=; for dep in $(grep -oE 'host-deps:[^*]*' tests/host/wait_queue_hosttest.c | sed 's/host-deps://'); do case $dep in rach2/sys/*) deps="$deps ${WORK}/b/$dep" ;; *) deps="$deps $dep" ;; esac; done; ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -Wno-int-to-pointer-cast -Wno-pointer-to-int-cast -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/arch/x86 -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/arch/i686 -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/lib -I ${WORK}/b/rach2/sys/proc tests/host/wait_queue_hosttest.c $deps -o ${WORK}/wait_queue_hosttest

faults.name: wait-unarmed
faults.summary: a wait that a wake does not end blocks again without its deadline armed

faults.name: wake-every-kind
faults.summary: a wake counted for every kind, not the kinds it names

faults.name: wake-count-set
faults.summary: a wake's count set to 1, not counted each time it comes

faults.name: wakes-every-kind
faults.summary: the count read back for every kind, not the kinds asked for

faults.name: wake-none-skipped
faults.summary: a wake that names no kind wakes no waiter
